  • Bachelor of Applied Science Degree

The Bachelor of Applied Science with a Major in Technical Occupations (BAS) was created to accommodate transfer students with Associate of Science (AS), Associate of Applied Science (AAS) and Associate of Occupational Studies (AOS) degrees from regionally accredited community or technical colleges. Now, students can complete a bachelor’s without significant, if any, loss of previously earned credit hours. Here are the key features of the program. For complete details contact the BAS academic advisor at start@csc.edu or 800-CHADRON.

Features

  • CSC will accept up to 66 semester credit hours of transfer courses toward completion of the BAS from all regionally accredited two year institutions. 
  • Plenty of online courses available to complete the degree online.
  • Low cost-per-credit hour for online learners.
  • Online courses offered in 4-week (summer), 8-week, and 16 week formats.
  • Flexibility. You and your advisor work together to develop a plan of study for your upper division requirements.
  • Customizable. Pre-approved upper division courses can be chosen from several disciplines.

Degree Requirements

The Bachelor of Applied Science with a Major in Technical Occupations has the following general requirements. Other policies may apply for graduation.

  • Minimum of 120 semester credit hours
  • 30 semester credit hours of approved Essential Studies courses.  Students must fulfill Essential Studies minimum credit requirements in each of the categories under Institutional Learning Outcomes 1-4.
    Essential Studies requirements may be reduced by comparable transfer courses. It is recommended that students select upper division courses in order to help achieve the necessary 40 upper division credit hour requirement.
  • 40 semester credit hours of approved upper division courses
  • Complete the CSC application
  • Entry into the BAS requires evidence of an AS, AAS, or AOS degree or comparable credits earned
